International Outlets Cover Trump, Xi, and Trade Tariffs

Multiple international outlets have focused on upcoming summits and diplomatic maneuvers involving U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. The president of the Halifax International Security Forum warned that Trump would attempt to "steal" midterm elections. Separately, discussions around Trump's trade tariffs highlighted their negative impact on small businesses, with one report noting specific reasons for this sentiment. The Japan Times also indicated potential meetings between Japanese officials and the U.S. president amidst bilateral differences.
